setup.title: Setup guide
setup.subtitle: Go step by step — each task takes a few minutes.
setup.allDoneDescription: Company info, catalog, and quoting are ready. Create and send your next estimate.

company.title: Enter your company name
company.description: Trade name shown at the top of estimates and invoices.
company.tip: Use the name customers know — e.g. "Smith Electric LLC".

contact.title: Add contact details
contact.description: At least email or phone so clients can reach you.
contact.tip: Use the same number you give customers on site.

address.title: Enter your business address
address.description: Full address printed on PDF documents.

tax.title: Add tax information
tax.description: Tax ID for invoices and official documents.
tax.tip: EIN in the US; VAT number in the EU.

quoteDefaults.title: Set quote defaults
quoteDefaults.description: Markup, tax rate, currency, and standard terms.

items.title: Add items to your catalog
items.description: Save materials and labor you use on every job.
items.tip: Units: sq ft, hour, each — add to quotes in one tap.

clients.title: Add your first client
clients.description: Name, phone, address — quick pick when quoting.
clients.tip: Start with one real customer; duplicate later.

firstEstimate.title: Create your first estimate
firstEstimate.description: Pick a client, add lines, export PDF or share link.
firstEstimate.tip: Save as draft first, send when ready.

logo.title: Add your logo
logo.description: Logo URL makes documents look more professional.
logo.tip: Square PNG, at least 200×200 px recommended.

license.title: License or insurance info
license.description: Extra trust line — contractor license, insurance summary.
license.tip: Optional but helps win bigger jobs.

recentQuotes.title: Recent estimates
recentQuotes.description: Pick up where you left off

materials.title: Item List
materials.description: Build a list of commonly used materials and labor rates — add to estimates in seconds.
materials.formDescription: Save items you use often and add them to quotes in one tap.
materials.itemDatabaseDescription: Name, unit (m², hours, pieces), and cost per unit.
materials.emptyDescription: Add your common materials and labor rates to speed up quoting.
materials.confirmDelete: Delete this item from your catalog?
materials.bannerDescription: Easily calculate material & labor costs. Select saved items instead of retyping on every job.

clients.title: Client Management
clients.description: Stay organized and manage customers on the go.
clients.formDescription: Store client info for quick quote creation.
clients.clientListDescription: Name, email, phone, and address for each client.
clients.emptyDescription: Add your first client to start creating quotes.
clients.deleteHasQuotes: Cannot delete — this client has quotes linked.
clients.bannerDescription: Create, organize, and store valuable client info. Access anytime, on the go.

quotes.title: Estimates
quotes.description: Win more clients on-the-spot with quick and professional estimates.
quotes.emptyDescription: Create & share estimates in just minutes — be first to get an estimate in your client's hands.
quotes.listBannerDescription: Create estimates with deposits, markups, line items & photos. Send for approval and convert to invoices instantly.

quoteBuilder.title: New Estimate
quoteBuilder.description: Create & share estimates in just minutes with our easy-to-use estimating tool.
quoteBuilder.noClients: Add a client first to continue.
quoteBuilder.saveError: Could not save quote. Check all fields.
quoteBuilder.successDescription: Your quote is ready to send. Download the PDF or view all quotes.

1.title: Client
1.description: Choose an existing client or add a new one.

2.title: Line items
2.description: Add from catalog or enter custom items.

3.title: Markup & tax
3.description: Apply margin and tax — totals update live.

quoteBuilder.bannerDescription: Four steps: client → line items → markup, tax & deposit → save & send PDF.
quoteBuilder.reviewHint: Review totals before saving. You can download PDF and email it to your client.

hints.selectClient: Who will receive this quote? Add new clients without leaving this page.
hints.markup: Profit margin applied to subtotal (e.g. 20% covers overhead and profit).
hints.tax: Sales tax or VAT applied after markup.
hints.validUntil: Quote expiry date. Default is 30 days from today.
hints.notes: Payment terms, warranty, scope. Pre-filled from Settings if configured.
hints.deposit: Request a deposit before work begins — Joist Basics.
hints.personalMessage: A personal note included on the estimate for your client.

draft.description: Edit by duplicating or create a new quote. Mark as Sent when you share it with the client.

sent.description: Mark Approved when they accept, or Declined if they pass.

approved.description: This amount counts toward your approved revenue on the dashboard.

declined.title: Quote declined
declined.description: Kept for records. Duplicate to create a revised quote if needed.
